result:
I’d make it harder for people to dehumanize one another.

Not by forcing kindness, but by making the “other” feel unmistakably real—so that cruelty requires more effort than compassion. Most of the world’s worst damage begins when someone becomes an abstraction: enemy, outsider, obstacle, label.

If that were broken, everything else might start bending toward something better.
